# AGENTS.md — {{package-name}} (generated by craft-scaffold, family: minimal)

Human style guide: `docs/style.md` (authoritative for look decisions).
Copy-app notes: never add as a dependency; standalone `[workspace]`.

## Rename contract (already applied by the generator)

`{{app-id}}` = `APP_ID` + `Prefs::APP_ID` + SVG URI prefix + config folder.
`{{display-name}}` = macOS menu + document heading. `{{AppStruct}}` = app struct.

## Invariants (do not break when extending)

- Shell order in `ui`: `menu-bar` → document → `status-bar`. Ids
  (`menu-bar`, `status-bar`, `Unsaved changes`) are global egui ids — stable.
- `logic` order: close decision → `store.tick` (+ `request_repaint_after` on
  `next_deadline`) → `craft_quit::on_close_request` LAST. No painting in `logic`.
- `on_exit` owns `store.flush()`; nothing durable after `run_native` in `main`.
- Every body through the panel frame (`12/10/10/8`); icons through the icon
  slot (square + `fit_to_exact_size`); buttons via `IconButton` + `Response`.
- `Tokens` is the ONLY place for shell colors. `Brightness` serializes as
  stable camelCase — never rename a variant.
- `#[serde(default)]` everywhere; never `deny_unknown_fields`; schema change =
  bump + idempotent `migrate`.
- Never `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`/`todo`; no `unsafe`. Report via
  `LoadReport`/`TickResult`/status bar, keep running.
- One SVG URI prefix per catalog/style per egui context.

## Before merging

cargo fmt --check
